title: A power station as a heat engine
caption: The station takes in Q_h = 2500 MW of heat, outputs W = 1000 MW of electricity and rejects Q_c = Q_h − W = 1500 MW to the cooling towers or a river. Efficiency η = W/Q_h = 40%. The rejected heat cannot be avoided entirely: the second law forbids η = 100%.
alt: Energy flow: 2500 MW of heat in, 1000 MW of electricity out and 1500 MW of waste heat; efficiency 40 percent.
description: 2500 MW of heat enters the engine from the hot source.
1500 MW is rejected to the cold sink. Efficiency = 1000 ÷ 2500 = 40%.
